description: Shared document envelope produced by every adapter. Both adapters must produce these fields identically for the same PDF. Adapter-specific content (records[], sections[]) follows after this envelope in each adapter's output.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Importer rejects files it cannot read.

schema_type.description: Identifies this as the shared document envelope.

document_id.description: SHA-256 hex of raw PDF bytes. Computed by shared/document_id.py. Stable across re-runs. Used by importer to deduplicate and to join records from different adapters that processed the same PDF.

metadata.description: Raw PDF metadata baked in by the publisher.

pdf_type.description: Importer gates all downstream processing on this. scanned = no text layer = write stub only.

is_digital.description: True when the PDF has a native text layer. False means fitz returns empty text and extraction cannot run.

needs_ocr.description: Always false for digital PDFs today. When OCR pipeline is built, importer uses this to route scanned PDFs to a different path.

has_links.description: Whether the PDF contains any hyperlinks.

has_internal_links.description: Whether the PDF has internal navigation links. DTC adapter uses these to match codes to pages. If false, adapter falls back to Y-position matching (lower confidence).

link_count_sample.description: Sampled internal link count. Indicates link density. Null if not computed.

vehicle.description: Vehicle identity. Every record in the database is tagged with these.

is_ev.description: Quick EV filter for importer and semantic search. Null when not determined.

source.description: How and where vehicle info was found. Lets importer decide whether to trust the value or flag for review.

make_from_lookup.description: True when make was resolved via vehicle_lookup.json rather than extracted from the PDF directly.

section.description: Namespaces all records in this file. code is the section identifier (EVB, TM, etc.).

adapter_name.description: Which adapter wrote this file. Importer routes differently per adapter.

extraction_status.description: Machine-readable outcome. Importer acts on this field, never on errors[] strings.

extraction_completed.description: Convenience boolean. True only when extraction_status is success.

extracted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when extraction finished.

errors.description: Non-fatal issues encountered. Always an array — empty when no errors.
